items.title: Osaka Public University — ~500 servers down, backups encrypted
items.summary: Attackers breached the university's virtualization infrastructure, took nearly 500 servers offline and encrypted many backups; data on up to 130,000 students and alumni may be exposed, and classes were suspended to Oct 9.

items.title: DexCom listed by Redact ransomware group
items.summary: The US medical-device maker appeared on Redact's leak site on Oct 10; the claim has not been confirmed by the company.

items.title: Andersen Group claimed by SilentRansomGroup
items.summary: A US professional-services firm was listed as a SilentRansomGroup victim on Oct 6; the claim is unverified.

items.title: SilentRansomGroup posts two more partially redacted victims
items.summary: Victims shown only as 'A…n' (Oct 5) and 'K…' (Oct 7) were posted with full names pending, which points to an active extortion pace this month.

ransomware.note: Check Point counted ransomware attacks up 53% year on year in September 2026, and Bitdefender counted 790 claimed victims that month. Leak-site claims are unverified.

items.title: Wikipedia outage during emergency maintenance
items.summary: On Oct 21, Downdetector reports peaked above 2,000 in the US and 850 in the UK around 10:51 ET during emergency Wikimedia maintenance, and service recovered within about an hour.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV logins halted over a PHP vulnerability
items.summary: Square Enix took its patch servers offline on Oct 21–22 as a precaution against a critical PHP vulnerability, which blocked new logins on every world for about an hour.

outage.note: AWS, Azure and Google Cloud reported no major outages in the past 24 hours. Both items above come from Downdetector-style reports.

items.title: CISA urges immediate patching of Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day
items.summary: An authentication bypass that allows unauthenticated remote command execution has been exploited since at least Oct 1, and Volexity reports a tracked actor chaining it with two other flaws. Verify the CVE ID against NVD before acting.

items.title: Joomla iCagenda and Balbooa extension zero-days added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added two Joomla extension flaws (incl. CVE-2026-48939) to the KEV catalog after active zero-day exploitation.

items.title: KEV catalog: 247 additions so far this year, most with 3-day deadlines
items.summary: From Jan 1 to Oct 1 2026, CISA added 247 KEV entries. Since BOD 26-04 replaced BOD 22-01 on Jun 10, 91 of the 114 new entries carry a three-day remediation deadline.

items.title: Critical PHP vulnerability prompts precautionary shutdowns
items.summary: Square Enix took its patch servers offline on Oct 21 over a critical PHP flaw. Operators running PHP should check vendor advisories.

items.title: M 6.9 — 76 km NE of Ozernovskiy, Russia (Oct 16)
items.summary: Kamchatka earthquake with a USGS green alert and no tsunami.

items.title: M 6.3 — 197 km NW of Port-Olry, Vanuatu (Oct 20)
items.summary: Offshore earthquake with a USGS green alert. The tsunami flag was set, and no significant tsunami damage has been reported.

items.title: M 5.7 — 48 km WNW of Khuzdar, Pakistan (Oct 17)
items.summary: Shallow inland earthquake with a USGS yellow alert for possible casualties and damage.

items.title: Isaias aftermath — Gulf Coast to Mid-Atlantic
items.summary: Isaias made landfall near Destin, FL, and became post-tropical. About 500,000 customers lost power and around 10 million people were under flood alerts from north Florida to southern Virginia, and restoration continued in Florida and Alabama.

items.title: Rachel remnants flood the Southwest; Hurricane Simon threatens western Mexico
items.summary: Post-tropical Rachel flooded Las Vegas and killed at least four people in Baja California, while Hurricane Simon threatened flash flooding and mudslides along Mexico's Pacific coast.

physical.note: The tropical items date from about Oct 10–12 because searches found no newer storm coverage, and no current wildfire events turned up.
